question.name: CSEC Bio May 2022 Q5a(i) — Functions of Blood Components
question.text:
Complete the table below by dragging the correct function into each blank for the three blood components shown.

Blood ComponentFunction
Red blood cells (RBC)[[1]]
White blood cells (WBC)[[2]]
Platelets[[3]]
question.general_feedback:
Functions of blood components:

  • Red blood cells (RBC): Transport/carry oxygen from the lungs to body tissues (via haemoglobin)
  • White blood cells (WBC): Fight infection — destroy pathogens by phagocytosis or by producing antibodies
  • Platelets: Blood clotting — seal wounds and prevent excessive blood loss

groups.label: Function of red blood cells
groups.diagnostic_hint: Red blood cells contain haemoglobin which binds oxygen in the lungs and releases it to body tissues. They have no nucleus, giving more space for haemoglobin.

options.text: Assist in blood clotting to seal wounds
Carry carbon dioxide to the lungs only

groups.label: Function of white blood cells
groups.diagnostic_hint: White blood cells are part of the immune system. They fight infection by engulfing pathogens (phagocytosis) or producing antibodies (lymphocytes).

options.text: Assist in blood clotting to seal wounds
Carry carbon dioxide to the lungs only

groups.label: Function of platelets
groups.diagnostic_hint: Platelets are cell fragments that initiate blood clotting (coagulation) at wound sites, preventing excessive blood loss and infection entry.

ddwtos.word_bank_note: 6 tokens for 3 slots. 3 correct + 3 distractors. 'Regulate body temperature' — plausible but not the primary function of any of the three components listed. 'Carry carbon dioxide to the lungs only' — RBCs do transport CO₂ but this is incomplete/misleading (RBCs primarily carry O₂); serves as a distractor for slot 1. 'Produce hormones for immune response' — WBCs produce antibodies (not hormones), so this catches terminology confusion.
